title: Design System: GHC Operations Manual Editor

body.purpose: Standard paragraphs and operational SOP text.

motion.name: ease-out-quint
motion.purpose: Smooth fade transitions for panel toggles.

components.name: Sidebar Item Active
components.description: Selected state item in file explorer sidebar.
components.css: .ds-sidebar-item { display: flex; align-items: center; width: 100%; border: none; padding: 6px 12px; font-family: var(--font-sans), sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border-radius: 8px; text-align: left; background: transparent; color: #4b5563; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-sidebar-item.ds-active { background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.1); color: #b45309; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Minimal Toolbar Button
components.css: .ds-btn-tool { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: none; background: transparent; color: #4b5563; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-tool:hover { background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05); color: #1f2937; }

narrative.overview: The Garrison Honors Center visual system is designed to mimic a clean physical notepad—combining borderless writing surfaces, subtle hairline borders, and warm amber accents. This system prioritizes speed, high-density reading, and content clarity, ensuring that staff can navigate and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) without layout distractions.
keyCharacteristics: Borderless Sheets: Document editors stretch to fill the screen viewport natively, eliminating artificial paper shadows.
Warm Amber Accent: Warm gold-amber selections are reserved strictly for active elements and folder states.
Hairline Dividers: Spacing and containment are defined by 1px dividers rather than filled background blocks.

rules.name: The Single Accent Rule
rules.body: Amber highlights must occupy less than 5% of any screen. If the accent is rare, it stays meaningful.

rules.name: The Zero Shadow Rule
rules.body: Floating shadow blurs are prohibited. Depth is conveyed strictly through borders (1px) and dark/light mode background tints.

dos: Do wrap long prose in text-wrap: pretty to prevent typographic orphans.
Do check contrast ratios for gray labels to ensure they meet the 4.5:1 readability standard.
Do keep headings aligned to the start of the borderless page.
donts: Don't use side-stripe colored borders on alert cards or callout items.
Don't use gradient text or colored card background containers.
Don't exceed a border-radius of 10px on buttons, inputs, or sidebar panels.
